title: nan
authors: Song Y.; Xian B.; Zhang Y.; Jiang X.; Zhang X.
key_contribution: Presents autonomous hovering and trajectory tracking for quadrotor UAVs in GPS-denied urban/indoor environments using miniature laser range finder and Point-to-Line ICP (PLICP).
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
